text:
Maya_marketing: Quick heads-up — I'm sketching a tiny launch: 'snack-snippets' refapp series (5 micro-tutorials + one-click deploy). Goal: lower bar for devs + drive inbound leads. Need: launch post, a short benchmark snapshot, 20-30m demo webinar, and clear lead routing. Timeline: ship first batch in 10 days.

Priya_devrel: Love it. I can own tutorial copy + repo README. Plan: each tutorial = 1 page + 1 Docker/helm quickstart + demo GIF. Can we standardize a template (TOC, install, quickstart, example request, GIF)?

Leo_eng: I'll add a tiny perf section per refapp. One table per repo: p50/p95 latency, tokens/sec, cost/token, recommended model/quant. Keep it short and reproducible. Suggested blurb: "Approx 110 tok/s on a T4-equivalent; ~0.7ms/token amortized with prefix-cache." We should include a reproducible bench script.

Alex_growth: Routing plan: HubSpot form + hidden UTM -> lead source = "snack-snippets". Micro-landing per refapp with CTA: "Try hosted" or "Deploy locally". I'll wire tracking and tag by refapp so SDRs can filter.

Maya_marketing: For the launch post: 1) 3-sentence narrative about dev speed, 2) benchmark snapshot, 3) 3 GIFs (quickstart, deploy, run), 4) CTA to repo + webinar signup. Draft headline options?

Priya_devrel: Options: "Ship LLM features in minutes: 5 micro-refapps" or "Snackable refapps to get an LLM feature production-ready". Keep it active, developer-forward.

Leo_eng: Bench narrative should emphasize two axes: cost-efficiency and predictability. Also add one-sentence note on fallback/routing: "Redwood can route to cheaper quantized variants when load spikes to preserve latency SLOs."

Alex_growth: Webinar format: 20m demo (walk the quickstart + perf), 10m Q&A. Gate the webinar with the HubSpot form; include a select box "Which refapp are you most interested in?" so we can route leads.

Sam_ops: I will add LaunchBot hooks so CI posts deploy preview URLs into the channel when build finishes. Also create Zapier flow: form -> hubspot -> assign to inbound queue "snack-snippets".

LaunchBot: CI: snack-refapp-1 build started (ci/5027). Will post preview on success.

Maya_marketing: Assignments: Priya = templates + GIFs + repo PR; Leo = bench scripts + table; Alex = landing + forms + tracking; Sam = LaunchBot + HubSpot mapping. I'll draft launch post and social copy.

Priya_devrel: Small ask: include a one-line deploy example in the README for approachability, e.g.:
```
redwood deploy snack-refapp-1 --quickstart
```
Also will include scripts/bench.sh that prints p50/p95 and estimated cost.

Leo_eng: OK. Bench script should be tiny: curl loop -> measure latencies -> compute p50/p95. Keep numbers reproducible.

Alex_growth: Social copy plan: short (tweet style), medium (LinkedIn), long (dev blog snippet). A/B test short copy across community vs org accounts. I'll post draft variants later.

Sam_ops: One ops note: make sure HubSpot form includes "I want a demo/help with deployment" checkbox. SDRs prefer triage flags.

Maya_marketing: Timeline check: draft post + landing by day 5; repo + perf by day 7; final QA + launch + webinar signup live day 10. Everyone good?

Priya_devrel: Good for me.

Leo_eng: Good.

Alex_growth: Good.

Sam_ops: 👍 I'll get automations running today.

Maya_marketing: I'll loop in design for GIF styling (800x450, 3-5s). Tagging @Priya_devrel @Leo_eng @Alex_growth @Sam_ops for follow-ups. Thanks! :tada:
